_about: Global supplier CRM record for Dashboard → Suppliers module. Import one supplier via top-level "supplier", or multiple via "suppliers" array.
_for_ai_models: Return ONLY valid JSON. Use envelope { "supplier": { ... } } OR flat root with same keys. For bulk: { "suppliers": [ {...}, {...} ] }. Required: companyName. Use status: active|inactive|prospect|negotiating|approved|rejected|blocked. productCategory from: Agriculture, Food, Packaging, Printing, Plastic, Polymer, Chemical, Logistics, Shipping, Customs, Machinery, Construction, Electronics, Medical, Textile, Furniture, Mining, Consulting, Marketing, IT, Finance, Others. general.country = country name or ISO code (CN, IR, OM). tags[]: { label, color } — omit id. Nested arrays: products, supplierServices, proposals, evaluations, internalNotes, communications, reminders, documents. Proposal status: new|under_review|negotiating|accepted|rejected|expired|archived. Evaluation criteria 1–5: quality, price, communication, deliverySpeed, packaging, reliability, responseTime, flexibility, documentation, professionalism. Omit id/createdAt/updatedAt on import — app assigns new ids.
